source: v7 Parts A/B supplied by human in current chat,2026-10-25
scope: infrastructure prototype; not a complete qualified reading harness
units: explicit ordered unit arrays; upstream transcription tokenizer not implemented
keys: fixed map and enumerated context conjunctions; provenance per base unit and rule; finite value/condition inventory; process evidence
custody: unknown exposure defaults ineligible; all four reserved folios rejected; duplicate/overlapping rowIDs rejected

evaluations.E2: explicit supplied token-pair identity or supplied lexical relation
evaluations.E3: fixed order2 add-half characterLM trained only on decoded training lines; shuffledminusreal bpc
evaluations.E4: negative bpc under a fixed independently partitioned target corpus LM
evaluations.E5: supplied exactsequence/sum checks; full zodiac arithmetic adapter not implemented
evaluations.E6: type consistency and undecodable token rate

complexity: map entries*log2(value inventory)+rule slots*(log2(condition inventory)+log2(value inventory)); section rules are explicit charged slots
C3: >=1000 keys; identical units/rule positions; base/rule value multisets separately permuted
coherence: sum signed binomial likelihood-ratio bits or bpc gains*observed character count relative to C3median, minusK; rates use fixed Jeffreys smoothing at zero/one baseline
rank: conservative >= upper tail with plus-one MonteCarlo correction; pass rankp<=0.01
verdict: singleview PASS iff coherence>0,>=2 E1–E5 above threshold, E3/E4 exceed both C1 variants and C2; finalPASS requires both H/F
unknowns: rate failures retained in denominators; lossmetrics NOT_ESTIMABLE when any unknown/ambiguous token, preventing favorable deletion
unimplemented: C3 mapping optimizer and all four corrected nulls
